controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from its measured spectrum; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of the star's measured spectrum (Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 381). The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Howarth (2011), MNRAS 413, 1515 computes from ATLAS9 model atmospheres for the Bessell V band at 24,820 K and log g 2.89, read between the models t24000g28, t24000g30, t25000g28, t25000g30 (u1 0.128, u2 0.390): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
